title: DRU-Mixer: An Explainable Dilated Recurrent Unit-Based Mixer Model with Focal Loss for EEG-Based Interictal Epileptiform Discharges Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.28030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interictal epileptiform discharges (IED) have been identified as a core electroencephalogram (EEG) biomarker in diagnosing epilepsy patients. However, automatic detection and classification of IED require significant effort by human experts and can be prone to inter-rater variability. This paper presents Dilated Recurrent Units (DRU)-Mixer, a deep learning network to automate the process of identifying and classifying IED based on EEG recordings. The proposed architecture comprises a convolutional front end for extracting local features, dilated recurrent units modeling the temporal relationship between EEG signals, and mixer modules for token- and channel-level representation learning. DRU-Mixer was trained to perform (i) binary classification of IED/Non-IED segments and (ii) multiclass classification of regional IED types. For binary classification, DRU-Mixer showed 95.19% accuracy, 72.76% precision, 82.31% recall, 96.61% specificity

translated_title: DRU-Mixer：一种基于可解释扩张循环单元并采用焦点损失的混合器模型，用于基于脑电图的发作间期癫痫样放电检测
translated_abstract: 发作间期癫痫样放电（IED）已被确认为诊断癫痫患者的核心脑电图（EEG）生物标志物。然而，IED的自动检测和分类需要人类专家投入大量精力，且容易出现评分者之间的差异。本文提出了扩张循环单元混合器（DRU-Mixer），这是一种深度学习网络，用于基于脑电记录自动识别和分类IED。所提出的架构包括用于提取局部特征的卷积前端、用于建模脑电信号之间时间关系的扩张循环单元，以及用于token级和通道级表示学习的混合器模块。DRU-Mixer被训练用于执行：（i）IED/非IED片段的二分类，以及（ii）区域性IED类型的多分类。在二分类任务中，DRU-Mixer达到了95.19%的准确率、72.76%的精确率、82.31%的召回率和96.61%的特异性。
tldr: 本文提出了DRU-Mixer，一种结合卷积前端、扩张循环单元和混合器模块的可解释深度学习模型，能够从脑电图中自动检测和分类发作间期癫痫样放电，二分类准确率达95.19%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DRU-Mixer, an explainable deep learning model combining a convolutional front end, dilated recurrent units, and mixer modules to automatically detect and classify interictal epileptiform discharges from EEG recordings, achieving 95.19% accuracy in binary classification.
